title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
All positions in this record are paper signals; no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade says nothing about a strategy. The live record starts at different dates for the engines: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That trade exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Open positions and recent closed trades

- htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 5 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade.
- The only position still open in the described record is NEAR, entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026.
- The first live signal was ATOM, entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, for −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.

The exit rule for that ATOM trade was a close below the 10-day low. The measurement at the exit close was 1.703, producing −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That is one closed trade, so it does not establish a durable result for either engine.

## Market filter and distance to breakouts

- trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and its closest names to a 20-day breakout are TRXUSDT at 12.12% below its high, ATOMUSDT at 16.17% below its high, and THETAUSDT at 18.02% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and its closest names to a 20-day breakout are JUPUSDT at 1.57% below its high, TRXUSDT at 12.12% below its high, and ATOMUSDT at 16.17% below its high.

Those percentages are recorded distances from current levels to recent highs. They show how far each name sits from its 20-day breakout point in this snapshot. With the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper, both trend-daily engines show no active trend exposure in this record.

## Reading a small sample

The closed-trade averages are -13.22% for v005 across 6 trades and -13.34% for v006 across 7 trades, while htf-rsi-v007 shows an average null net per trade across 5 trades. Those are small counts. The ATOM result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip sits inside the range of a strategy where, in testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%. A losing first trade is therefore consistent with the stated expectation, but it does not prove or disprove anything. Nothing in this snapshot establishes a durable edge.

## Continuity and verification

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-19T21:25:25.581Z. The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Paper signals only; no real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
